acceptance_bar: The nine read as one sitting when laid out together, not as three, and no frame jumps against its neighbours.
She still looks like herself. No smoothing, no visible retouching signature, no preset look.
All four crops are delivered for the placements named, each composed for the size it is actually used at rather than cropped down from one master.
The version with nothing behind her holds its edge on the dark ground her press kit and deck use, with no pale outline in the hair and no hard-cut curl, checked on that ground and not on white.
The version on the warm neutral is a warm neutral and she reads cleanly against it at every delivered size.
No invented pixels anywhere. No delivered file is larger than its source, and the note lists every picture any tool resized or extended, and by how much.
The monogram is placeable artwork with no white box behind it, and the note says honestly where it holds and where it does not, including at profile-picture size and reversed on the dark ground.
If the monogram will not hold somewhere she asked for it, that is named in writing with what to use instead, not quietly shipped broken.
All three canvases sit in ONE editable file, each keeping its own canvas size, and she gets the self-contained source it was built from.
The words in that file are live text she can retype and the monogram in it is real vector artwork, not a picture of a layout.
Anything licensed sits with her own photography rather than reading as a stock picture behind her.
One type system across all three canvases, with the note naming per role the family, its foundry or designer, and the weight actually used.
The board carries the finished set with nothing silently missing from it.
The note says, per frame, what was applied, and names any frame that could not be brought to the set.

trajectory.action: Confirm the account tier, pull the authoring playbook, and settle what lands where: the pictures and the monogram on imaging, the three canvases on HTML authoring.
trajectory.judgement: There is no variable-data half to this commission, so the temptation is to treat the whole thing as a crop exercise. The actual structure is that four of the deliverables are defined by the ground or the size they have to survive, and one is defined by being editable next month.
trajectory.produces: A plan naming deliverable to surface and the confirmed tier.

trajectory.action: Upload the nine frames, the card photograph and the workshop snap, holding a manifest with source dimensions.
trajectory.judgement: Source dimensions are recorded here because every no-invented-pixels claim later is made against them.
trajectory.produces: A manifest with source dimensions per file.

trajectory.action: Preview all nine and triage: which part of the afternoon each came from, how the grey behind her reads in each, how much room there is around her, and how her hair sits against the ground.
trajectory.judgement: The client has already picked her favourite as the press headshot, and the triage has to establish independently whether that frame can be brought to where the other eight are going. Accepting the client's hero without testing it against the set is the fast answer and it is the one that ends with eight frames matching each other and not the one she sends to organisers.
trajectory.produces: A per-frame triage note and a stated view on the client's chosen hero.

trajectory.action: Fix one look on the strongest frame and correct the other eight toward it, one call per frame, recording parameters.
trajectory.judgement: The target is a set. Frames from the two halves of the afternoon need different corrections to arrive at the same place, and a batched call applies one identical parameter set. The band rules out anything that reads as a preset signature.
trajectory.produces: Nine corrected masters with a per-frame parameter log.

trajectory.action: Masked work where a whole-frame move is wrong: correct the ground or the sitter separately by naming the material rather than the object it sits on.
trajectory.judgement: Prompt wording is the whole gate, and skin and paper want opposite moves that cannot both be served globally.
trajectory.produces: Corrected frames where a global move would have taken the ground green or the skin warm.

trajectory.action: Produce the warm-neutral ground version in one operation where the frame allows it, and produce the ground-free version for the press kit and the deck.
trajectory.judgement: The one-call ground route and the select-invert-fill route are not interchangeable and the choice is per frame. The ground-free version has only one source of edge softness, and it is the same operation that produces the ground version, so the two are not independent decisions.
trajectory.produces: Warm-neutral and ground-free variants across the set.

trajectory.action: Place the ground-free versions on the deep ground her press kit and deck use and inspect the hair and shoulder edges close up.
trajectory.judgement: This is the only place the edge can be judged, because both failure modes are invisible on white and on the warm neutral. Deciding to look is the agent's own move; nothing prompts it.
trajectory.produces: An edge verdict per frame on the ground that matters.

trajectory.action: Compose the four crops for the four placements at the sizes each is actually used at, reading each crop's tradeoff metadata, and extend a frame at its edges rather than interpolating it where a placement needs more room than the frame holds.
trajectory.judgement: A profile picture and a banner are not the same crop scaled; the smallest placement needs the tightest composition and the widest needs room the studio frame does not have. The tradeoffs array is the only signal that a crop interpolated, and adding edge material is the only route that does not.
trajectory.produces: Four composed crops per selected frame, with a resize and extension record.

trajectory.surface: Photoshop and Lightroom imaging, vector recovery
trajectory.action: Recover the monogram from the deboss card: a selection worded at what actually distinguishes the mark in this photograph, inverted for polarity, cropped to the selection's bounds, traced, then given a viewBox with the opaque ground path removed. Produce a solid variant for reversing.
trajectory.judgement: There is no ink to select, so the usual wording that takes a printed mark off a substrate has nothing to grip and the selection has to be aimed at what the photograph actually contains. Polarity decides whether the trace is a mark or a filled box, and background removal is the wrong instrument on letterforms with enclosed counters.
trajectory.produces: A transparent, scalable monogram plus a solid variant for the dark ground.

trajectory.action: Place the traced monogram at the profile picture's delivered size and reversed on the deep ground, and look at both.
trajectory.judgement: The two hardest placements she named are the two smallest and the two most reversed, and neither can be judged at canvas size. Looking at the mark at its real delivered size is a decision the agent has to make.
trajectory.produces: A verdict on the monogram at its two hardest placements.

trajectory.action: Search Stock with short generic queries for a workshop or studio environmental frame, filter to photography, exclude generative results, license and download at full resolution, then bring it toward her look and lay it beside her graded frames.
trajectory.judgement: Choosing a frame whose existing light can be brought to hers rather than the best thumbnail, and then judging whether it sits with her photography or reads as a stock picture behind her. A 240 pixel thumbnail is not evidence about light.
trajectory.produces: One licensed camera-scale environmental frame, graded and judged against the set.

trajectory.action: Ask for recommendations once per typographic role, read the family style inventories for real numeric weights, launder every name, and build one kit.
trajectory.judgement: The pairing is the agent's own and has to read as a design studio founder at institutional level. Weight cannot be inferred from the style name, a display cut is reached by its own family slug, and the CSS must use the returned stack.
trajectory.produces: A one-kit type system with family, foundry or designer and real weight per role.

trajectory.action: Author one self-contained HTML with three roots at three canvas sizes: the speaker one-pager at true physical dimensions, the wide banner and the square announcement. Embed every photograph as image data, place the monogram as inline vector inside an explicitly sized and top-left anchored wrapper, and declare family and weight on every text element.
trajectory.judgement: A photograph left as a URL is not a photograph, an auto-sized right-anchored wrapper throws its contents off the canvas, weight is not inherited from markup semantics, and a global canvas override collapses a mixed-size set. The design work is how much air the one-pager carries and how quietly the monogram sits at this band.

trajectory.action: Run the readiness check, export, then verify through the two channels that exist: resolve the document's rendition and look at the first canvas, and parse the returned per-canvas markup for the other two, asserting per canvas that every photograph resolved to real image data, that the monogram arrived as vector shapes, and that nothing resolves past its declared canvas width.

trajectory.produces: A native editable document with three canvases, an inspected first canvas and a markup audit of the other two.

trajectory.action: Create the board and add the finished set for her co-founder, treating a partial success as partial. Then write the note: per frame what was applied, any frame that could not be brought to the set, the type system, and an honest statement of where the monogram holds and where it does not with what to use instead.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: What a blind deboss actually yields as artwork, and whether it survives the two placements the client named as the ones she cares about. There is no ink and no colour in the mark: it exists only as the shadow the raking light threw into the paper relief, and only on the side the light came from, so what a selection returns is a property of that photograph's light rather than of the monogram. The trace comes back as a set of soft shadow shapes that read convincingly as the two letters at full canvas, which is the only size at which anyone would look at them by default, and which break into disconnected fragments with one side of each letterform missing at the size a profile picture reproduces them, and lose their remaining edge entirely when reversed on the deep ground. Nothing reports any of this. The tracing step takes no options at all, so there is no parameter to have set correctly; the only lever is the raster preparation, and which preparation is needed cannot be chosen until the failure has been seen at real size on the real ground.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) Ordering cannot dodge it and care cannot pre-empt it. The trace's fidelity is a function of this photograph's raking light, the paper's texture and the selection that produced it. There is no measurement, no preview at delivered size, and no parameter on the trace. An agent that words the selection carefully and gets the polarity right still cannot know how much of each letterform survives without tracing it and putting it at avatar size. (b) Nothing states it. The brief says the monogram is pressed into the paper with no ink and that it has to survive on a profile picture and reversed on the dark ground, which is the client naming her hardest placements and her standing requirement, exactly as she would to a designer. It does not say it will fail, and no asset note, earlier step or deliverable says which letter breaks or on which side. The client asking for a note about where it will and will not hold is a request for professional advice, not a disclosure that the answer is already known. (c) It is not a propagation re-run. The response is to go back and make a different asset: re-prepare the raster so the relief carries a usable edge before tracing, aim the selection at a different property of the photograph, or accept that the traced mark is a large-format asset only and build a different small-size lockup from the letterforms. Whichever it is, the one-pager, the banner and the announcement are then re-composed around a mark of a different weight and a different minimum size.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Re-prepare the raster to strengthen the relief before tracing rather than trying to fix the trace, re-select on a wording aimed at what actually distinguishes the mark in this frame, re-trace, strip the ground path and inject a viewBox again, and re-place at profile-picture size and reversed on the deep ground rather than assuming the second attempt took. If it still will not hold at the smallest size, decide and state what carries that placement instead, and re-author the canvases around the mark's real minimum size, which changes the composition rather than just the asset.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: A founder raising a seed round uses a profile picture on which her monogram is a smear of disconnected grey shapes, and sends conference organisers a press kit whose mark disappears entirely into the dark ground, having been handed artwork that looked perfect in every file she was shown.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether the ground-free version actually holds where it is used. She has thick curly hair, the studio grey behind her sits close in value to it in the frames shot after the light was moved, and the knockout resolves that either by cutting hard into the curl or by leaving a soft rim of captured grey around it. Which of the two a given frame gets is a property of that frame's light and that part of her hair, not of the route chosen or the care taken, and both are completely invisible on white and on the warm neutral ground, which is exactly why every version she has tried herself looked fine until it went on her deck. The operation reports success in both cases and the returned file looks correct at normal viewing size.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) Ordering cannot avoid it. The ground-free version has to be made regardless of order, there is no metadata that reports edge quality, and no measurement is available. A careful agent choosing the right route still gets a rim or a hard cut on the frames where hair and ground share value, because the photograph is the variable. It also cannot be settled by inspecting the returned file in isolation: the failure only exists relative to the ground it is composited on. (b) Nothing states it. The brief says every version she has tried has a pale outline round her hair, which is the client describing the symptom that made her hire someone, not a description of which frames do it, why, or that the fix is ground-dependent. No asset note names the frames and no acceptance line explains the cause. (c) It is not a propagation re-run. The fix is a different operation on a different principle, naming the paper behind her and inverting rather than asking for the subject, plus a decision about whether a frame whose curl cannot be cut cleanly stays in the set at all, which changes which frame carries which placement.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Re-cut the affected frames by naming the ground material and inverting rather than by asking for the subject, re-composite on the deep ground and inspect the curl again rather than assuming the second route worked, and check the frames that were not flagged at the same close inspection, since the reason to look was found on one frame and the rest have not been established as clean. If a frame will not cut cleanly at all, move the placement it was carrying to a frame that will and say so.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: Her press kit and her investor deck both carry a portrait with a pale halo traced round every curl on a very dark ground, which is the precise defect she hired someone to fix, shipped back to her as fixed.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether a licensed environmental frame can sit with her own portraits. Stock search returns a small CDN thumbnail; the frame's true light, its true neutral and its true black point only exist after it is licensed, downloaded at full resolution and brought toward her look, and whether it then reads as her studio or as a stock picture placed behind her is only visible with it and her nine graded frames laid out together. Two candidate frames that look equally warm and equally quiet at thumbnail size can be a full grade apart at full resolution, and one of them will never join a set built on a studio portrait's soft key.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) Ordering cannot avoid it. The comparison needs both the licensed frame and the finished set to exist, so it cannot be moved earlier, and it cannot be settled by care, because a thumbnail is not evidence about light. (b) Nothing states it. The brief says only that the banner wants more room than a studio frame and that she will pay for one if that is what it needs, which is an invitation carrying no claim about how a candidate will behave. No asset, no acceptance line and no earlier step names it. (c) It is not a propagation re-run. The likely response is to abandon the licensed frame and search again on different terms, which is a new licensing decision, a new grade and a new judgement, not the same operation on changed input, and it may instead resolve into extending one of her own frames at the edges and accepting a tighter banner, which changes the banner's composition and the type that sits on it.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Push the licensed frame further toward her look, or, if it will not join, return to Stock with a search framed by the light her set actually has rather than by the subject matter, license a replacement and re-grade it, then lay the set out again and judge it as ten rather than checking the new frame alone. If nothing joins, extend one of her own frames at its edges instead and re-compose the banner around the room that produces, which is a different banner.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: The banner at the top of a founder's profile reads as a bought photograph with a portrait pasted on it, in front of the investors and programme committees the whole kit exists to persuade.

deliverables.name: Vellacourt session set, nine frames at one look
deliverables.spec: Nine frames from a shifting afternoon brought to one composed, credible, understated look with no visible retouching signature and the sitter still recognisably herself, delivered at the four placement crops composed for the size each is actually used at rather than scaled from one master, every output at or below its source dimensions, with a per-frame parameter log and every resize or edge extension any tool reported. One set with one look, not nine separately optimised pictures and not one picture at four sizes.

deliverables.name: Warm-neutral and ground-free portrait variants
deliverables.spec: Each selected frame delivered on the warm neutral ground the client asked for, replacing the studio grey, and as a ground-free version whose edge holds on the deep ground her press kit and investor deck use, with no pale rim and no hard-cut curl, judged on that ground rather than on white. Where a frame cannot be cut cleanly, it is named and the placement it was carrying is moved.

deliverables.name: Recovered AV monogram
deliverables.spec: The monogram recovered from a photograph of a blind-debossed card as placeable, scalable vector geometry with a real viewBox and no opaque full-canvas ground path, delivered as a transparent mark and a solid variant for reversing, together with an honest written statement of where it holds and where it does not, specifically at profile-picture size and reversed on the deep ground, and what to use instead wherever it does not.

deliverables.name: Speaker one-pager, banner and announcement as one editable document plus its source
deliverables.spec: A single native editable Express document carrying a speaker one-pager at true physical dimensions, a wide banner canvas and a square announcement canvas, each keeping its own canvas size, with live editable text in one licensed type system, the monogram as real vector shapes and every photograph carried as embedded image data. Delivered with the self-contained source it was authored from, since the event name and date change every time.

deliverables.name: Handover note and review board
deliverables.spec: A written note recording per frame what was applied, any frame that could not be brought to the set and why, the type system by role with foundry or designer and the actual numeric weight, the honest account of the monogram's limits and the alternative for the placements it cannot carry, whether anything was licensed and why, and every resize or edge extension any tool reported. Paired with a persistent shareable board carrying the finished set for her co-founder to sign off, with nothing silently dropped.

decision_gates: Whether the client's chosen press frame can be brought to where the other eight are going, and what to say if it cannot.
How far each half of the afternoon is pushed to reach one look, and where a correction stops being a correction and becomes a preset signature.
Knockout route per frame rather than per set, and on which ground the edges are judged, given that both failure modes are invisible on white.
Whether a frame whose curl will not cut cleanly stays in the set, and which placement moves if it does not.
Composing four crops for four delivered sizes rather than deriving them from one master, and which frame carries which placement.
Whether to extend a frame at its edges or accept a tighter banner, knowing extended material has to match her own ground.
How to word a selection on a mark that has no ink and no colour, where the usual wording for lifting a printed mark off a substrate has nothing to grip.
Which raster preparation gives the relief a usable edge before tracing, given that the tracing step takes no options at all.
Whether the traced mark is a large-format asset only, and if so what carries the small placements instead.
Whether the licensed environmental frame joins her photography or reads as bought, and if bought, whether to push it, search again on the light, or abandon it for an extended frame of her own.
The type pairing, which the recommender refuses to make, judged against an institutional founder rather than a personal brand.
How much air the one-pager carries and how quietly the monogram sits. At this band restraint is the design.
What to escalate in writing versus what to fix silently, on a commission where the client explicitly asked to be told where her own mark will not work.
why_not_vlm: Paste the brief and the assets into a frontier image model and it returns a portrait of somebody who is not her. IDENTITY is the entire commission: these are nine frames of one specific person who is about to ask investors for money and conference committees for stage time, and her monogram is a specific impression in a specific piece of paper from a printer that has closed. A regenerated face is fraud and a regenerated monogram is a different studio's mark. SPEC: she needs four crops composed for four named delivered sizes, a version on a warm neutral ground and a version with genuine transparency whose edge holds on a dark ground, all at or below source resolution. A generated image satisfies none of that and cannot be checked. EDITABILITY: one deliverable is defined by being editable, three canvases in one document she changes per event so she is not paying for this four times, with live text and real vector geometry. And the middle of the engagement is verification against material reality: does this hair cut cleanly on the ground it will actually sit on, does this shadow trace still read at avatar size, does this licensed frame sit with her portraits. None of that is a generation problem, and the honest note about where her mark will not hold is professional advice a render cannot give.
doability_proof: Four surfaces, honestly counted and deliberately not padded: there is no genuine variable-data run in this commission, so the InDesign surface is not invoked rather than being manufactured, and the Illustrator tools are never called because document_render_vector and document_merge_data_vector sit on a polling helper that does not exist in this host. Every link is verified in CONNECTOR_CAPABILITIES_v3 (2026-09-10, auth account). IMAGING: masked and unmasked image_apply_adjustments, auto_tone, select_by_prompt and select_subject with returnBbox, invert_selection, fill_area, remove_background in both the transparent and the backgroundColor forms, crop_to_bounds, crop_and_resize with its tradeoffs array, generative_expand and vectorize are all verified headless across the audit's live calls. The one-call solid-ground knockout is verified and is the correct route for the warm neutral; transparent RGBA with genuinely feathered partial alpha is verified and survives both crop tools at png output, which is what the ground-free deliverable depends on, and the documented note that outputFileType must stay png through the whole chain is why a single jpeg step would destroy it. remove_background is documented as failing on disjoint marks and enclosed interiors, which is why the monogram is recovered by selection, inversion and tracing rather than by background removal. vectorize takes no options at all, emits no viewBox and always emits an opaque first path, all verified, so the hygiene the deliverable gates on is real work the agent must do itself. The prompt-wording asymmetry, where naming the substrate returns the substrate and naming the mark's own visual properties returns the mark, is a verified live finding, and a blind deboss is precisely the case where the mark has no colour or medium of its own to name, which is what makes the preparation the only lever. crop_and_resize is documented as interpolating to a hard cap and reporting it only in tradeoffs, and remove_background is documented as silently downscaling oversized inputs and reporting it only as a tradeoff, so the no-invented-pixels bar is scored as a decision plus a disclosure rather than as any measurement the agent takes. EXPRESS: mixed canvas sizes in one export are verified, true physical canvases resolve exactly at absolute units, inline SVG becomes native editable vector, external image URLs render as empty placeholders so every photograph is embedded as image data, and the right-anchored auto-sized wrapper failure is a verified live finding the trajectory designs against. Transport goes through the text/html upload path because embedded photography exceeds the inline threshold, and verification is split because the rendition preview shows the first canvas only. Persistence is not assumed, so the deliverable is the editable document plus the self-contained source. FONTS: the recommend, styles, find, kit chain is verified end to end in a real browser, and the non-standard numeric weights, the display-cut-by-slug rule, the slug-not-PostScript CSS rule and the all-or-nothing kit call are all live findings the task leans on. STOCK AND BOARDS: short generic queries only because long queries return zero hits, the orientation filter is broken and never passed, licensing returns genuine camera-scale imagery, and boards persist with a twelve-placement cap where 201 means partial success with a failed-items list. VOLUME: eleven client image files in, roughly twenty-six image artefacts moved in total, every multi-image call at or under the ten-item cap and no batch above twenty. AVOIDED: no video or audio, no vector render or vector merge, no variable QR, no fill_text, no animate_design, no create_firefly_board, no replace_image, no download_design, no upscaling, no OCR, no compositing, no AI object removal, no from-scratch image generation, and no photograph reaching Express as a URL.

engagement_title: Halcyon Quarter launch at Beckett Wharf: bring a cloudy-afternoon shoot to one dusk-glow house look, recover the hand-painted monogram off the hoarding board, and carry both onto the site hoarding, the portal listings, the lender's payment cards and the launch kit
vertical: Real Estate and Property, off-plan residential development launch on a former rope works site, Providence, Rhode Island, sold through a boutique brokerage with a partner lender
real_brief_anchor: Primary anchor AO-119 (specs/AO-119_harbor-crest-realty-stock-hero-crop-bann.json), Freelancer.com 'Vibrant Social & Web Graphics', quoted VERBATIM in its grounding_note: the client wants 'matching website graphics, hero images, section headers, and call-to-action spots, plus occasional banner ads for promotional campaigns', every asset should 'feel part of one cohesive family while being perfectly sized, compressed, and formatted for its destination', with 'Web-ready exports in the correct dimensions and file types' and a 'Mini style reference (colours, typography) to keep future assets consistent.' Co-anchor AO-24 (specs/AO-24_mortgage-open-house-flyer-asset-prep-and.json), Upwork, a Northern California mortgage lender wanting an 'editable... template package' for an 'Open House Finance Flyer (front and back)... Designed for both print and digital use', 'Sophisticated / Luxury but approachable / Clean and modern', which 'must allow easy editing of: Property photos, Purchase price, Monthly payment scenarios, Down payment options, QR codes, Appreciation projections, Contact information'. Third anchor AO-47 (specs/AO-47_redraw-vector-swimming-pools-web.json), Upwork, which wants photographs 'redrawn' as 'high-quality, detailed' vector images 'visually appealing and meet the website's standards'. All three are the same commission seen from three angles: a cohesive sized-to-destination image family, an editable finance piece per unit type, and a mark recovered as usable vector. The prior PHOTO-05 sat on one surface (a hero grading recipe) and is rebuilt here as the launch a developer actually buys. All brands are laundered to fiction (Kestrel and Vane Developments, Halcyon Quarter, Harbor Crest Realty, Kestrel Home Lending); no real person, place, brand or trademark survives.
client_one_liner: Our shoot day was overcast from start to finish and we are selling the evening, so bring the whole set to one dusk, get our sign-painted monogram back as artwork, and give us the hoarding, the portal images, the lender's payment cards and a launch kit we can edit ourselves.
client_brief:
Halcyon Quarter, Beckett Wharf. Launch photography and launch kit.

We are Kestrel and Vane, a small developer. Halcyon Quarter is fifty two apartments on the old rope works site, and phase one releases in seven weeks. Harbor Crest Realty sell it for us and Kestrel Home Lending are our finance partner, so whatever you make has to work for all three of us.

Our photographer had one day and it was overcast the whole way through. She shot the show apartment, the roof terrace, the residents' lounge, the canal frontage and two elevation views. The pictures are competent and they are flat. What we sell at this price is the evening: warm light inside, the water going blue, the terrace worth standing on. We need the set to arrive at that one moment and to look like it was shot that way, not like six different afternoons.

Sizes. The largest piece is the hoarding across the site gate, which is a long band printed very big (our printer works at one tenth scale). The portal wants standard landscape listing images. The brokerage posts a portrait and a square. We would rather you tell us a frame cannot carry a size than see it go up soft on a fence eight feet high.

Our monogram only exists as sign paint. The sign writer brushed it onto the hoarding board and we have a photograph of it. We need it back as artwork we can place anywhere at any size, including reversed out of a dark photograph, and it has to still be our monogram.

Kestrel Home Lending run one payment card per apartment type and they send us the wording, all of which is theirs and none of which may be edited, shortened or re-spaced by us. We have the file their printer ran last spring and nothing else. Every number has changed.

We also need the launch kit: the sales suite flyer, the three website slots and the two social sizes, all in one file we can edit ourselves, because release dates move.

Tone: these start at seven hundred and eighty thousand and our buyers are leaving houses they have owned for thirty years. Quiet and expensive, not shiny. Tell us anything you think we should know.
price_band_and_audience: Off-plan apartments from $780,000 to $1.45m, professional downsizers aged 50 to 65 leaving a family house within twenty miles. The band is load-bearing. At this price the evening treatment is the product: restrained warm interior light against a cool blue hour exterior, generous margins, a text serif with real hierarchy, prices set plainly inside the copy, and one photograph doing the work per canvas. The same scheme sold as $1,600 a month rental would be shot flat, bright and midday, laid out dense and price-led, and the dusk treatment would read as overselling. An agent that ships a saturated orange sunset, a starburst price or four amenity thumbnails on the flyer has misread the commission even if every technical gate passes. Engagement price band: a posted job of this shape runs $2,200 to $4,500 fixed, or $55 to $90 per hour across 35 to 50 hours.

assets_supplied.name: halcyon_shoot_raw/ (6 frames, 5504x3670)
assets_supplied.kind: image, camera scale, one day, overcast
assets_supplied.visible_description: "Show apartment, roof terrace, residents' lounge, canal frontage and two elevation views. Same photographer, same day, same camera."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: Three things nobody at the client knows. (1) The cloud thinned for forty minutes in the middle of the day and the two interior frames were made in that window: they carry a different illuminant and sit a full stop higher in key than the four exteriors, so a single treatment does not bring the six to one evening. (2) Only ONE frame carries the complete elevation, it is framed tight with the parapet close to the top edge, and it is 3:2, so the hoarding's long band cannot be cropped from it without cutting the parapet. (3) On the roof terrace frame the glazed pavilion sits at almost exactly the value of the flat overcast sky behind it, so a selection along that roofline fringes where a selection on the other five frames is clean. Every frame looks entirely plausible on its own, which is why the client believes they are one shoot.

assets_supplied.name: hoarding_panel_monogram.jpg (4032x3024)
assets_supplied.kind: image, phone photograph of the site hoarding board
assets_supplied.visible_description: "Our monogram, brushed onto the hoarding board by the sign writer. It is the only version there is."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: Sign paint on a primed board, not a flat scan. Naming the board pulls a selection to the board; naming the paint's own visual properties pulls it to the letters. The interlocked K and V are joined by a fine bar, the brush loaded at two corners so the counters are partly bridged, and the board's grain and a low sheen sit inside the painted area. How much of the interlock bar and the counters survive THIS photograph's paint through a trace, at the size the flyer masthead and the hoarding actually reproduce it, reversed out of a dark blue-hour photograph, is a property of this photograph that no tool reports and no earlier step can predict.

assets_supplied.name: kestrel_payment_card_2025_PRINT.pdf (148 x 105 mm landscape)
assets_supplied.kind: document, flat press PDF from the lender's printer, fonts embedded, produced by a full layout engine
assets_supplied.visible_description: "What the lender's printer ran last spring. We do not have the working file and neither do they."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: The printed card reads as eight separately labelled fields. The conversion does not expose eight frames: the placed images split the flow into TWO text frames only, and the payment scenario block plus the rate and term line share one continuous story as tabbed runs. Worse, the mapping readout of that story silently omits the rate and term run while KEEPING its line break, so the string still parses as well-formed and every character offset after it is short by exactly that run's length. The validator returns valid on the resulting arithmetic, the placeholder step reports success, and the two regulated disclosure fields never become placeholders.

assets_supplied.name: halcyon_units_2027.csv
assets_supplied.kind: data, one row per apartment type out of the sales system
assets_supplied.visible_description: "Every apartment type with the lender's wording against it. The wording is theirs, do not touch it."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: The export carries one more row than the client's stated phase one type list: a type withdrawn from phase one that the sales system still emits, with a null price. The deposit column mixes percentages and dollar amounts across rows, headers are mixed case with trailing spaces, and the photo column is a plain header holding bare filenames that neither match the shoot folder as delivered nor satisfy the merge's own image column contract.

assets_supplied.name: kv_brand_notes.txt
assets_supplied.kind: document
assets_supplied.visible_description: Half a page from the developer: 'blue hour', 'brass not gold', 'the water should look cold and the rooms should look warm', 'nothing shiny'. No hex values, no measurements.

acceptance_bar: The six frames read as one evening when laid side by side, one white point, one warmth, one black point. A frame that cannot be brought to the set is named and replaced, not shipped at eighty percent.

Nothing in any picture may show the scheme as something it is not. If any frame was extended to reach a size, say which frame, by how much and on which edges, and the extension may not add or remove anything a buyer could count.
No delivered file exceeds the pixel dimensions of the frame it came from, and every enlargement any step reported is listed in the note.
The hoarding band is delivered at the largest honest size the source supports, with the parapet and the full elevation intact.

The monogram is placeable artwork rather than a picture of artwork: transparent, scalable, no ground rectangle underneath it, and still our monogram reversed out of a dark photograph at the size the flyer masthead uses.
One payment card per apartment type currently in phase one, in the sales system's order, one type to a page.
Every card carries every line of the lender's wording including the rate and term line. A card missing a line is a failed card even though the file opened.
The lender's wording is not reworded, shortened, re-spaced or abbreviated anywhere, and no page ships with any of it clipped at true trim.

The launch kit is ONE file we can edit: the flyer, the three website slots and the two social sizes, each at its own canvas size, with live text, the monogram as real vector shapes and every photograph actually visible in it.
One type system across the flyer, the web slots and the social sizes, named in the note by role with family, foundry or designer, and the actual weight used.
The shared board carries every graded frame and anything licensed, with nothing silently missing from it.

A written note: what was done to each frame and why it differs from its neighbours, anything questioned in the units export and what was done about it, and anything you could not deliver inside the lender's card.

trajectory.action: Confirm the account tier, pull the authoring playbook, and settle which deliverable lands on which surface.
trajectory.judgement: The split is the first real decision and the brief does not state it. Payment cards are record-per-type against a layout the lender's printer already owns, so they belong on the merge surface; the launch kit needs six different canvas sizes and client editability, which a merge template cannot do. The brief pins the destination (one editable file plus what it was built from), so there is nothing to stall on.
trajectory.produces: A written plan naming surface per deliverable, and the confirmed account tier.

trajectory.action: Upload every supplied asset headlessly and hold each returned presigned URL against its role.
trajectory.judgement: Manifest discipline: thirty artefacts later the agent still has to know which URL is the elevation frame and which is the lender's PDF.
trajectory.produces: A role-keyed manifest of presigned URLs.

trajectory.action: Look at all six frames before touching a parameter: illuminant, level, subject tightness, and what pixel budget each frame can carry against the hoarding band, the portal landscape, the portrait and the square.
trajectory.judgement: The client asserts one shoot and the agent has to look and disagree. It also has to notice, now rather than later, that only one frame carries the whole elevation and how tight the parapet sits, because the hoarding budget depends on it.
trajectory.produces: A per-frame triage note with a dimensional budget per destination.

trajectory.action: Level the frames that are off before any crop geometry is derived from them.
trajectory.judgement: Levelling reframes and eats edge pixels, so it precedes crop decisions rather than following them.
trajectory.produces: Levelled masters where needed, originals untouched elsewhere.

trajectory.action: Fix one house dusk target from the frame with the most usable sky, then correct each frame toward it with its own parameters.
trajectory.judgement: The target is a set, not six good pictures. Two frames need a materially different correction to arrive at the same place, and a single batched parameter set would apply one identical correction to six frames that are not in one condition.
trajectory.produces: Six graded masters at source scale plus a per-frame parameter log.

trajectory.action: Masked work where a global grade is wrong: warm the window interiors and terrace lamps without taking the sky orange, cool the canal water without draining the brick.
trajectory.judgement: Prompt wording is the whole gate: naming the object pulls to the object, naming the material's own visual properties pulls to the material. One roofline sits at the sky's value, so a mask that fringes there has to be recognised as fringing rather than accepted because the call returned success.
trajectory.produces: Region-confined corrections on the frames a whole-frame grade would have broken.

trajectory.action: Derive the portal landscape, portrait and square crops from the graded masters, reading the confidence and tradeoff metadata each crop returns.
trajectory.judgement: The tradeoffs array is the only signal that a crop clipped, that a detection was weak, or that an output was interpolated upward, and it is easy to skip.
trajectory.produces: Destination crops with a no-enlargement record drawn from what each call reported.

trajectory.action: Build the hoarding band. The banner ratio cannot be cropped from the elevation frame without cutting the parapet, so widen the frame on its short axis with a recorded seed and then crop to the band.
trajectory.judgement: Choosing to gain width rather than clip or enlarge, and choosing where the added width goes: the canal side, the street side, or split. Whatever is added becomes part of a picture that advertises a building that does not exist yet.
trajectory.produces: A widened elevation frame at the band ratio, with the seed and the per-edge expansion recorded.

trajectory.action: Bring the widened band to the house dusk and lay the hoarding hero next to the five other graded frames at reproduction scale.
trajectory.judgement: Judging the added material as material, not as a successful call. The band has its own colour temperature and its own sky gradient, and it also has whatever content it invented along the join.
trajectory.produces: A hoarding hero the agent has actually inspected against the set.

trajectory.action: Search short generic queries for the one interior atmosphere frame the shoot did not get, filter to photography, exclude generative-tech results, license and download at full resolution.
trajectory.judgement: Choosing a frame whose existing light can be brought to the house dusk rather than the prettiest thumbnail. A 240 pixel proxy is not evidence about light.
trajectory.produces: One licensed, IP-clean, camera-scale frame.

trajectory.action: Grade the licensed frame toward the house dusk and judge it adjacent to the six.
trajectory.judgement: Whether it joins the set, gets pushed further, or is abandoned for a different search.
trajectory.produces: The atmosphere frame, in or out, with the reasoning recorded.

trajectory.action: Recover the monogram: an ink-level selection naming the paint's own visual properties, inverted for polarity, cropped to the selection's bounds, traced; then fetch the trace, inject a viewBox and remove the opaque full-canvas ground path. Produce a colour-accurate variant as well as the two-colour mark.
trajectory.judgement: Three decisions the tools do not make: how to word the selection so it takes the paint and not the board, which polarity to trace, and which variant carries the masthead. Background removal is the wrong instrument on a mark with enclosed counters.
trajectory.produces: A placeable, scalable, transparent monogram plus a colour-accurate variant.

trajectory.action: Ask for recommendations once per typographic role, read the family style inventories for the real numeric weights, launder every name into canonical form, and build one kit for the whole system.
trajectory.judgement: The pairing is entirely the agent's and has to answer to a downsizer at $780k. The numeric weight cannot be inferred from the style name and the CSS must use the returned slug rather than the PostScript name; either mistake ships the wrong face with no warning.
trajectory.produces: A one-kit type system with family, foundry or designer and real weight recorded per role.

trajectory.surface: Data preparation and Creative Cloud storage
trajectory.action: Reconcile the units export against the client's phase one list and the lender's wording, normalise it into a merge-shaped file with an image column the merge will actually honour, upload the per-type plates and build the image map.
trajectory.judgement: Real reconciliation: the row count and the stated type count do not agree, and the deposit column is not one thing. Whether excluding a row the sales system emitted is the agent's call or the client's to confirm, and how to say so, is a judgement the client invited.
trajectory.produces: The merge data file, uploaded plates, the image map, and a first list of discrepancies for the note.

trajectory.action: Convert the lender's payment card PDF, export IDML from it, unzip it, and reconstruct the true story text of each frame by concatenating its content runs.
trajectory.judgement: The mapping strategy is a property of the lender's PDF, not of the plan: per-frame replacement if the fields came across separately, offset arithmetic inside one story if they did not. Which text the offsets are computed from is a decision nothing prompts, and only one of the two available texts is the document.
trajectory.produces: The converted document, its IDML, a real frame inventory with integer page-item ids, and an independently reconstructed story text.

trajectory.action: Author the mapping covering every field plus the image frame, pass it through the validator, prepare the template, then export IDML from the RESULT and grep the story for every placeholder the mapping claimed to create.
trajectory.judgement: Not accepting a success message as evidence. Nothing in the chain instructs this verification and nothing warns if it is skipped, and it is the only place the mapping's real yield is visible before pages exist.
trajectory.produces: A merge template whose placeholder inventory has been independently confirmed.

trajectory.action: Merge to a native document with the per-row plates bound, render at 300 ppi to the press file and to proofs, then read every card at true trim against the lender's wording line by line.
trajectory.judgement: Route matters and is irreversible in practice: merging straight to raster drops to screen resolution regardless of what was requested, and merging straight to PDF forfeits per-record files. Reading the output rather than the log is the only way a missing line or a clipped line is ever seen.
trajectory.produces: The press card set at trim and 300 ppi, proofs, and a card-by-card reconciliation.

trajectory.action: Produce the per-type single-page files and name each to its apartment type, verifying identity by opening each file rather than by its position in the returned list.
trajectory.judgement: The order of returned per-record artefacts is not trustworthy on every route, and naming by position is the fast wrong answer that puts the wrong payment scenario in front of a buyer.
trajectory.produces: One named, identity-verified single-page card per apartment type.

trajectory.action: Author one self-contained HTML carrying the A4 flyer, the three website slots and the two social canvases, each root declaring its own canvas size; base64 inline every photograph; place the monogram as inline SVG inside an explicitly sized top-left anchored wrapper; declare family and weight on every text element; then upload the HTML and export it by URL.
trajectory.judgement: The craft the agent must already carry: a photograph left as a URL is not a photograph, an auto-sized right-anchored wrapper throws its contents off the canvas, weight is not inherited from markup semantics, and a global canvas override collapses a mixed-size set. The design decisions (how much air at this band, how large the monogram sits on the blue hour ground) are the actual work.
trajectory.produces: One export-ready HTML uploaded to an allowed host, retained as the durable source deliverable.

trajectory.surface: Adobe Express, then Boards and handover
trajectory.action: Run the readiness check, export, then verify through both channels that exist: render canvas one and look at it, and parse the returned per-slide markup for the other five. Then create the selects board, add the graded set and the licensed frame within the placement cap, and write the handover note.
trajectory.judgement: Treating a successful export as unverified, and knowing that looking at canvas one is not looking at the deliverable. On the board, a 201 is partial success and only the entries named as failed get re-sent.
trajectory.produces: A native editable Express document verified per canvas, a persistent selects board with nothing silently dropped, and the written handover.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: What the widened elevation frame actually contains, and whether it can join the set. Two facts exist only after the expansion runs. First, the added band is synthesised: whether it continues the paving and the canal plausibly, or fabricates a continuation of the building itself (another window bay, a second lamp standard, a run of railing) is a per-seed property of this frame that no parameter controls and no response reports. Second, the added band arrives with its own colour temperature and its own sky falloff, so whether it sits inside the house dusk once the frame is graded and laid beside the other five at reproduction scale is not knowable from the call's success.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) Ordering cannot dodge it and care cannot either. The band ratio is the printer's, the parapet position is the photograph's, and the only routes to the band are clipping the parapet (forbidden by the client's own size honesty line), enlarging (forbidden), or gaining width. Having chosen to gain width, the agent cannot learn what was added except by adding it and looking, and the fidelity of the addition is not a parameter. (b) Nothing states it. The brief asks for a frame that can carry the hoarding and says a picture may not show the scheme as something it is not, which is a standing advertising obligation an off-plan developer has anyway, not a disclosure that any particular expansion will invent a bay. No asset description and no earlier step names it. (c) It is not a propagation re-run. The response is a different composition decision: re-run with different seeds and a different per-edge split, re-cut the band from a different part of the frame, or abandon the elevation frame for the hoarding entirely and rebuild the hoarding around the canal frontage, which changes the crop policy and the grade target for the whole set.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Re-run the expansion with different seeds and a different left and right split, or with the whole gain on the water side where there is nothing to fabricate; re-grade the band into the house dusk and lay the twelve frames adjacent again; and if the addition keeps building architecture, re-plan which frame carries the hoarding, which changes the crop budget for the portal and social sets derived from it. Record the seed, the edges and the amounts in the note under the client's own honesty clause.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: An eight-foot hoarding at the site gate showing Halcyon Quarter with a bay that will never be built, standing over a phase one release, next to a warm patch of invented paving that reads a stop off the rest of the band. It is a misrepresentation of an off-plan property to buyers who will count windows when they visit.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: What the lender's printed card actually becomes as editable structure, and then whether the mapping built against that structure landed. Granularity arrives only by converting: whether the eight labelled fields come across as eight addressable frames or as two frames with the scenario block and the rate and term line sharing one tabbed story, and whether the photograph arrived as a real graphic frame with an integer id at all, are properties of how a printer nobody can ask built the 2025 file. Yield is worse: the mapping tool's readout of that story omits the rate and term run while keeping its line break, so the string still reads as well-formed prose and every offset past it is short by that run's length. The validator returns VALID on internally consistent wrong arithmetic, the placeholder step returns success, and two regulated fields never become placeholders. Only an independent reconstruction of the story from the exported content runs, plus a round trip and grep of the PREPARED file, makes either fact visible.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) Neither ordering nor diligence dodges it. Granularity is not a parameter, has no read-ahead, and is reached only by converting and looking. The yield failure is produced by a lossy readout that presents as complete, so an agent that reads carefully and computes offsets diligently from the readout it was handed produces arithmetic that is internally consistent and wrong, and every downstream tool agrees with it. The defence is a second reconstruction of the same text from a different channel, which nothing in any tool description prompts and whose necessity is invisible until the two disagree. (b) Nothing states it. The brief says only that the lender's wording is theirs and may not be edited, and that they have the printer's file and nothing else. The acceptance bar states an output requirement (every card carries every line including the rate and term line), which is the lender's standing regulatory requirement, not a description of a cause. (c) It is not a propagation re-run. What changes is the mapping strategy and its source of truth: from per-frame placeholder replacement against a tool readout to offset arithmetic computed against a reconstructed story, with same-frame rows re-ordered against the original text. The mapping is re-authored from a different text, not re-fed.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Reconstruct the true story from the exported content runs, recompute every offset against that string, order any rows sharing an id so their positions hold against the original text, rebuild and re-validate the mapping, re-prepare the template, and re-verify by round-tripping and grepping for every placeholder before a single card is merged. If the photograph did not come across as a mappable frame, re-plan the image binding before the merge rather than after.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: A set of payment cards that binds apartment type, price and deposit correctly on every page while the rate and term line is simply absent, silently, on every card, with every tool in the chain having reported success. It is a regulated disclosure omitted from a lender's own printed collateral, handed to buyers in a sales suite.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether the recovered monogram survives being made and being imported. How much of the interlock bar and the bridged counters this photograph's sign paint actually yields through a trace, and what path and fill count comes back, is empirical. Whether that mark still reads as the monogram at the size the flyer masthead and the hoarding reproduce it, reversed out of a dark blue-hour photograph, is a question about this trace at this size against this ground that no earlier step can answer. And how the importer normalises the trace once it arrives (as loose ungrouped geometry rather than one coherent mark, with whatever ground path rode along) is reported only in the returned per-canvas markup, and the rendition preview shows the first canvas only.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) Ordering cannot dodge it. Trace fidelity is a function of the paint, the board grain and the selection that produced it; the agent chooses the prompt and the polarity but not how much of a hairline bar survives, and cannot find out except by tracing and then placing the result at real size on the real ground. There is no first-time-right to aim at, only an empirical answer. (b) Nothing states it. The brief asks for the monogram back as artwork placeable at any size including reversed out of a dark photograph, which is the client's own standard for getting their mark back. It never asks how small the mark can safely go, which would have made the finding a stated deliverable. (c) It is not a propagation re-run. The response is to produce a DIFFERENT asset: re-select with a prompt aimed at a different element of the lockup, trace the colour-accurate knockout plate instead of the two-colour mask, or re-cast the masthead with the monogram demoted and the wordmark carrying it, and then re-author the launch kit around whichever that is.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Re-run the recovery with a differently worded, element-specific selection or via the colour-accurate plate to hold the interlock bar; reconsider the masthead's reproduction size and the mark-versus-wordmark lockup for the dark ground, which changes the flyer's composition; re-author the HTML around the chosen variant, re-upload, re-run the readiness check, re-export, and look again through both channels rather than assuming the second export took.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: A launch kit delivered as an editable file in which the masthead monogram is a smear of loose shapes with its interlock gone, reversed out of a dark canal photograph chosen for a mark that no longer reads, on the one piece a downsizer takes home from the sales suite.

deliverables.name: Halcyon Quarter launch photography, six frames plus one licensed frame
deliverables.spec: Six client frames brought to one dusk house look (one white point, one warmth, one black point) plus one licensed camera-scale frame graded into the same set, delivered at hoarding band, portal landscape, portrait and square, every output at or below its source pixel dimensions, with a per-frame parameter log and a record of every enlargement or expansion any step reported, including seeds and per-edge amounts.

deliverables.name: Recovered Kestrel and Vane monogram
deliverables.spec: The monogram recovered from a photograph of the sign-painted hoarding board as placeable, scalable vector geometry with a transparent ground, a real viewBox and no full-canvas ground path riding along, delivered as a two-colour mark and a colour-accurate variant, and holding legibly with its interlock intact at the size it is actually reproduced on the flyer masthead and reversed out of the dark exterior.

deliverables.name: Kestrel Home Lending payment cards, press set plus per-type files
deliverables.spec: 148 x 105 mm landscape, one apartment type per page in sales system order, page count equal to the phase one type count, rendered at 300 ppi at trim. Every card binds every field of the lender's wording verbatim including the rate and term line, plus that type's own plate in its image frame. Accompanied by one single-page file per type, named to the type and identity-verified by opening, and by 300 ppi proofs. Produced by reverse-engineering the lender's printed PDF into a live merge template, so the template and the record of how it was derived are part of the handover.

deliverables.name: Halcyon Quarter launch kit, six canvases as one editable document plus its source
deliverables.spec: A single native editable Express document containing the A4 sales suite flyer at true physical dimensions, the website hero band, the section header, the banner, the square and the tall social canvases, each root at its own canvas size. Live editable text in one licensed type system, the monogram as real vector shapes, every photograph carried as embedded image data rather than a reference. Delivered with the self-contained source HTML it was authored from, which is the durable half: the client edits the document when release dates move and the source guarantees the design survives regardless.

deliverables.name: Handover note and launch selects board
deliverables.spec: A written note recording per-frame corrections and why each frame differs from its neighbours; every expansion or resize any step reported with the frame, edges and amounts; the type system by role with family, foundry or designer and the real numeric weight; what the lender's PDF actually exposed and the mapping decisions taken against it so the next freelancer need not repeat the archaeology; every row questioned in the units export and its resolution; and anything that could not be delivered inside the lender's card. Paired with a persistent shareable selects board carrying the graded set and the licensed frame, with nothing silently dropped.

verifiers_auto.text: The merged press file has exactly one page per phase one apartment type, in sales system order.
verifiers_auto.how: Count PDF pages and compare with the reconciled row count; read each page's type name against the data file in order.

verifiers_auto.text: Every field of the lender's wording, including the rate and term line, exists as a placeholder in the prepared template and as text on every rendered card.
verifiers_auto.how: Round-trip the prepared template to IDML, unzip and grep the stories for each expected placeholder; then read all rendered cards at trim.

verifiers_auto.text: Cards render at 300 ppi at 148 x 105 mm trim (1748 x 1240 px).
verifiers_auto.how: Read the rendered raster dimensions and the JFIF or PNG density from the render output.

verifiers_auto.text: No delivered image exceeds its source frame's pixel dimensions, and every tradeoff entry reporting an enlargement, downscale or expansion appears in the handover note.
verifiers_auto.how: Compare delivered dimensions against source dimensions per frame, and diff the transcribed tradeoffs against the tool responses in the run log.

verifiers_auto.text: The delivered monogram SVG has a viewBox and no full-canvas opaque ground path, and reaches Express as vector path elements rather than one image.
verifiers_auto.how: Parse the SVG for a viewBox attribute and inspect path index zero; then parse the returned per-slide markup for path-type shapes on the canvases carrying the masthead.

verifiers_auto.text: The Express document contains six roots at six declared canvas sizes and no canvas carries a placeholder image or an element resolved beyond its canvas width.
verifiers_auto.how: Parse slides[] for count, per-slide width and height, image elements that resolved to the importer's 1x1 placeholder, and any resolved left or top beyond the declared canvas.

verifiers_auto.text: The selects board contains every graded frame plus the licensed frame, with no failed placements left unresent.
verifiers_auto.how: Compare returned addedEntityIds against the expected item list and confirm failedItems is empty across all calls.

verifiers_human.text: The six frames plus the licensed frame read as one evening rather than as one shoot plus corrections.
verifiers_human.how: Lay all seven adjacent at equal size and judge white point, warmth and black point as a set.

verifiers_human.text: The widened hoarding band contains nothing a buyer could count that the scheme does not have, and its added material sits inside the house dusk.
verifiers_human.how: Inspect the band at reproduction scale against the unwidened frame and against the other graded exteriors.

verifiers_human.text: The monogram still reads as the monogram, interlock intact, at masthead size and reversed out of the dark exterior.
verifiers_human.how: View the flyer masthead and the hoarding at true reproduction size on the actual ground colour.

verifiers_human.text: The launch kit reads as quiet and expensive rather than as a bright price-led property flyer.
verifiers_human.how: Judge margin, hierarchy, photograph count per canvas and price treatment against the $780k downsizer band.

verifiers_human.text: The handover note lets a different freelancer rebuild the payment cards from the same printed PDF without repeating the archaeology.
verifiers_human.how: Read the note for what the conversion exposed, the mapping decisions and the placeholder verification.

decision_gates: The surface split: payment cards to the merge surface because they are record-per-type against a layout that already exists, launch kit to HTML authoring because it needs six canvas sizes and client editability.
Whether the six frames are one condition. The client asserts they are; the two interiors are not.
How to reach the hoarding band from a frame that cannot be cropped to it: clip the parapet, enlarge, or gain width, and where the gained width goes.
Whether the added band is honest enough to advertise an unbuilt building, and what has to be said about it in writing.
Selection prompt wording on the hoarding board: naming the board takes the board, naming the paint's own properties takes the letters.
Which monogram variant carries the masthead, judged against how the trace actually reads at reproduction size on the dark ground.
Whether to trust the mapping tool's readout of the lender's text or to reconstruct the story independently from the document.
Whether a success message counts as verification of the prepared template.
The row count and the mixed deposit column: whether excluding a row the sales system emitted is the agent's call or the client's, and how to say so.
Whether per-type files are named by the order they came back or by opening each one.
The type pairing, which the recommender refuses to make, and the real numeric weight per family, which cannot be inferred from the style name.
Whether the licensed interior joins the set or reads as bought, and if bought, whether to push it or search again on the light rather than the subject.
How much air the flyer carries. At this band restraint is the design and a dense price-led sheet is a correct-looking wrong answer.
why_not_vlm: A frontier image model returns a picture of a launch flyer and fails all three gates. IDENTITY: the building is a specific unbuilt scheme whose elevation, parapet and canal frontage are what buyers will walk up to, and the monogram is a specific brushed mark that must be RECOVERED from a photograph of a board rather than reinvented; a regenerated elevation is a misrepresentation and a regenerated monogram is a different company's mark. SPEC: the lender needs one card per phase one apartment type in sales system order at 148 x 105 mm and 300 ppi with every regulated line bound verbatim from their own wording, plus one named single-page file per type; a generated image satisfies none of that and cannot be checked against an export. EDITABILITY: two deliverables are defined by being editable, a live merge template so next season's numbers are a data change, and a native document with live text and real vector geometry so release dates can move without a re-commission. And the middle of the engagement is verification against material reality (did this placeholder land, is this line on this card at trim, does this widened band contain a bay that does not exist, does this trace still read at masthead size), which is not a generation problem at all.
doability_proof: Five honestly counted surfaces, every link verified live in CONNECTOR_CAPABILITIES_v3 (2026-09-10, auth account). MERGE SPINE: convert_pdf_to_indd, export_idml, generate_indd_mapping_prompt, prepare_indd_merge_template and document_merge_data_layout are verified end to end from a bare press PDF; one record per page is confirmed for application/pdf, per-record named files are confirmed by createSeparateFiles and by a recordRange loop (both order-verified) while multi-record raster order is documented as reversed and is therefore avoided; 300 ppi at trim comes from document_render_layout because outputSpecs.resolution on the merge itself is silently ignored. The PDF asset is specified as a real font-embedding press PDF from a full engine, because thin hand-authored PDFs fail conversion opaquely. The frame-granularity behaviour is built to the verified shape: images interleaved with the flow split it into two text frames plus graphic frames, which is what this card carries, and the trajectory degrades gracefully whichever way it lands. The lossy-readout defect is verify-then-ship: before admission, run convert to IDML to mapping prompt on the manufactured PDF and confirm the readout is short by exactly one run against the reconstructed story; if it will not reproduce, the checkpoint still stands on granularity alone. IMAGE BINDING uses an @-prefixed column plus additionalImageFiles with keys matching bare filenames (verified at N=3) with a recordRange loop as the fallback that also guarantees per-record identity. IMAGING: auto_straighten, apply_adjustments masked and unmasked, select_by_prompt with returnBbox, invert_selection, crop_to_bounds, crop_and_resize with its tradeoffs and detection_confidence, generative_expand with seeds (the sole sanctioned generative call, edges only, up to 4096 px per side), fill_area and vectorize are all verified headless; the substrate-versus-ink prompt asymmetry, vectorize's missing viewBox and opaque path zero, and the loose-shape explosion in Express are documented findings. Upscaling is handled rather than asserted: crop_and_resize interpolates to a hard 2x cap and signals it only in tradeoffs, so the bar scores the decision and the disclosure separately, and the hoarding is specified at printer tenth scale so no gate requires enlargement. EXPRESS: mixed canvas sizes in one export, true mm print canvases (210x297mm to 794x1123px), inline SVG as native vector and a genuine editable .dcx are all verified; the HTML is routed through asset upload with media_type text/html and passed as url because six canvases of inlined photography exceed the 70 KB inline threshold. Verification is split to the two channels that exist: asset_inline_preview for canvas one, slides[].html for the rest. FONTS: font_recommend to font_styles to find_fonts to get_fontkit_embed_url is verified end to end including a real browser proving loaded faces; the non-standard numeric weight, the slug-not-PostScript rule and the all-or-nothing kit call are leaned on deliberately. STOCK AND BOARDS: short generic queries only (long queries return zero, orientation always returns zero), asset_license_and_download_stock returns genuine camera scale, boards persist with a hard cap of twelve placements per call and 201 meaning partial success. AVOIDED: no video or audio (no poll tools exist in this host), no document_render_vector or document_merge_data_vector, no variable QR, no bleed or pdfPreset gate, no fill_text, no animate_design or create_firefly_board, no replace_image, no download_design, no upscaling, no OCR, no compositing, no text-to-image, no photo reaching Express as a URL, and no batch above 20 files (13 client files in, roughly 34 image artefacts through the chain, every multi-image call at or under the 10-item cap).

engagement_title: Argent & Faith spring capsule: bring a two-morning bench shoot to one house look, recover the maker's mark out of the engraved bench block, and carry both onto the product pages, the boxed provenance cards and the stockist lookbook
vertical: Jewelry, Watches & Accessories (independent silver studio, Providence, Rhode Island, direct plus eleven independent stockists)
real_brief_anchor: Primary anchor: the Freelancer.com silver-jewellery lead behind the ledger entry for this slot, a seller wanting a 'modern design for a rosary necklace', silver as the primary material, a clean modern aesthetic and 'good communication skills for revisions'. The posted ask is to design and model a piece from scratch, which the connector grades out of scope (no text-to-image, no 3D, no from-scratch art), so the ledger honestly re-cast it as the production-art package such a seller commissions around supplied bench captures. Co-anchor: the Upwork jewellery/accessory brief that took a signature bracelet from concept through manufacturing for a new lifestyle brand, whose in-scope slice is the launch-imaging workload once prototypes exist, scaled from one hero to a whole opening capsule so cross-asset consistency is actually present. Co-anchor: the Freelancer.com silver-jewellery photo-editing open call asking for handheld product frames turned into a clean, colour-accurate, uniform set with 'pure/near-white background with no colour cast', 'accurate metal tone and true gemstone colour', plus 'matching transparent cut-outs for layering, delivered store-ready'. The ledger records that the last of those was amputated to one hero and called a repeatable recipe, which deleted the only genuinely hard thing in it. PHOTO-13 restores the full commission those three clients actually had: a ten-piece capsule shot over two mornings, a mark that exists only as an engraving, a boxed card the printer holds and the studio does not, and a stockist lookbook that has to stay editable. Brands are laundered to the fictional Argent & Faith; no real house, person or trademark appears.
client_one_liner: Ten pieces, five weeks, and the stockist order window opens the same day the pages go live, so the photography, the mark, the boxed cards and the lookbook all have to come back from one person looking like one studio.
client_brief:
Argent & Faith, spring capsule: product pages, boxed cards and the stockist lookbook.

We are a two-bench silver studio in Providence. Nora cuts and pierces, I finish and set, and we put out ten pieces a season, sold direct and through eleven independent stockists. The capsule goes live in five weeks and the stockist order window opens the same day, so all of it has to come from one person and look like one house.

The photography is where we are stuck. A friend shot the capsule for us on the bench under the north window, then came back a second morning for the three pieces that were still at the polisher. Every frame is good on its own. Put them in a row on a product page and they do not look like the same studio made them.

First we need the pieces themselves, cleanly separated from whatever is behind them and sitting on a plain ground, ready to drop into a listing. Two things matter more than anything else. The open centres of the bands and the pierced work in the medallion have to be genuinely open, because the negative space is the design and a filled centre reads as a casting fault to anyone who knows silver. And a piece has to look like it belongs on the ground it is sitting on, not like it was lifted off one surface and dropped onto another.

We want our mark back too. It exists as an engraving in the steel bench block Nora's teacher cut for her, and nowhere else. We need it as artwork we can place at any size: on the pages, at the foot of the boxed cards, and reversed out of dark on the lookbook cover. It has to stay our mark, not a tidier mark that resembles it.

Then the printed side. Every piece ships in a box with a card carrying its name, its metal and finish, its dimensions, its provenance line and its number. Our printer has last year's file. We do not, and the woman who made it has retired. Keep the card as it is, change everything on it, and send back a press file plus one card per piece, named so we can pull the right one without opening it.

Last, the stockist lookbook: a cover, a spread of the range and two social canvases, all in one working file we can edit ourselves, plus whatever it was built from. We will be changing prices and we are not paying for a redo every season.

On tone: pieces run one hundred eighty to nine hundred dollars and our buyer is twenty-eight to fifty-five, buying one considered thing rather than three cheap ones. Quiet, plenty of air, the metal doing the work. And if anything in our own list looks wrong to you, tell us.
price_band_and_audience: Retail 180 to 900 dollars (open bands 180 to 260, pierced medallion 420, signet 560, reliquary locket 900). Buyer 28 to 55, Northeast urban and coastal, buys one considered piece for herself or as a milestone gift and reads the metal and dimensions before buying. The band is load-bearing. At this tier the listing tile is mostly ground, the piece sits small and centred, the type is quiet and the provenance line is treated as editorial copy. A filled ring centre or a piece that reads as pasted onto its ground is not a cosmetic flaw here, it reads as a casting fault or a faked photograph and it kills the sale. If the same capsule sold at 25 dollars the correct answer would be the opposite artefact: busy flat-lays, four pieces to a tile, a price flash, and nobody would look at the centre of a band. An agent that ships a dense, price-led, high-saturation set has misread the commission even if every technical gate passes. A real posted job of this shape runs 1,600 to 3,200 dollars fixed, or 50 to 80 dollars an hour for 30 to 45 hours.

assets_supplied.name: bench_capsule/ (10 frames, 5472 x 3648)
assets_supplied.kind: Product photography shot by a friend of the studio across two mornings on the same light grey paper sweep on the finishing bench, one piece per frame.
